public_copy_note: No private names in on-image text.

slides.story_job: Break the grand-romance expectation and open the quiet-forever loop.
slides.visual_direction: Object-only overhead of a warm entryway table: two keyrings, two cups, a folded blank paper, a small tote strap, and two hands entering from opposite edges.
slides.swipe_reason: If love is not always big, what does it become?

slides.story_job: Name the core mechanic without explaining it to death.
slides.visual_direction: Wide hallway scene at home: Aachu and Zuv move through an ordinary leaving-the-house ritual, one reaching for the switch while the other checks the door, both already knowing the pattern.
slides.swipe_reason: The viewer wants examples of the default.

slides.story_job: Make the viewer recognize the tiny muscle memory of closeness.
slides.visual_direction: Close over-shoulder phone moment with the screen kept blank/no readable UI; a thumb hovers by instinct while the other partner is softly present in the background.
slides.swipe_reason: The default shifts from idea to private habit.

slides.on_image_text: THE EXTRA KEY YOU STOP HIDING.
slides.visual_direction: Detail shot of both hands at a door-side key hook: one hand adds a spare key to an everyday ring, the other steadies the hook; no labels or readable key tags.
slides.swipe_reason: The carousel moves from phone habit to shared access.

slides.on_image_text: THE SIDE OF THE BED THAT KNOWS YOU.
slides.story_job: Make forever feel bodily and routine, not performative.
slides.visual_direction: Morning bedroom medium shot: two pillows with lived-in shape, shared charger cable, Aachu tying her hair at the bed edge while Zuv reaches for a cup or folded blanket; quiet mutual rhythm, no caretaker pose.

slides.story_job: Turn the sweet default into adult stakes without making it dramatic.
slides.visual_direction: Calm clinic or paperwork waiting-room desk: Aachu fills a blank form with only blank lines visible while Zuv sits beside her, close and steady; their hands are near, one hand offers a pen or holds the bag. No readable form text.
slides.swipe_reason: The small default reveals why it matters.

slides.story_job: Land the lifelong thesis in one send/save line.
slides.visual_direction: Distant evening doorway view: the couple seen from behind hanging two keyrings and stepping into warm home light, shoes side by side, small paper grain and negative space above.
slides.swipe_reason: The viewer has a line worth sending.
